{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Re-load the data to be safe
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Filter for completed orders
completed_df = df[df['status'] == 'completed']

# Remove QA orders (revenue = '999,999.99')
completed_clean = completed_df[completed_df['revenue'] != '999,999.99']

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
completed_clean['revenue_clean'] = completed_clean['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Compute mean revenue for completed orders (after removing QA)
mean_revenue = completed_clean['revenue_clean'].mean()

# Output the number of completed orders after filtering QA
num_completed = len(completed_clean)

# Print all required values
print(f"Number of completed orders after filtering QA: {num_completed}")
print(f"Mean revenue of completed orders (after cleaning and removing QA): {mean_revenue}")"}
